response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore":"Moderate","gaps":"Lack of proper risk assessment for working near power lines, vehicle fleet maintenance records in spreadsheets, outdated competency records for fiber splicing, no safety objectives set","recommendations":"Conduct risk assessments for working near power lines, implement a digital fleet maintenance system, update competency records for fiber splicing, set clear safety objectives","standards":"ISO 45001, ISO 9001, ISO 14001"}
